steps.businessName: click Tickets button on landing view
click ADD on the Standard ticket card (1st time — transitions card to quantity widget)
steps.notes: id=add is shared by all 4 ticket-card ADD buttons. Disambiguated by DOM order (4 querySelectorAll('button#add'), idx=0 is Standard, 1=Premium, 2=Std Unlimited, 3=Prem Unlimited). After this click the card replaces ADD with quantity-dropdown + add-item + button-minus-ticket-quantity.

steps.businessName: click the + icon on the Standard ticket card (2nd unit — takes qty 1→2)
steps.notes: Quantity-widget + icon on the transitioned Standard card. On this view only Standard has the widget, so #add-item is unique. If multiple ticket cards are active simultaneously this id would also be shared — disambiguate by DOM order / card position.

steps.businessName: click the + icon on the Standard ticket card (3rd unit — takes qty 2→3)
steps.notes: Same #add-item as step 3 — Standard is still the only card with the widget at this point.

steps.businessName: click ADD on the Premium ticket card (1st time — transitions Premium card to quantity widget)
steps.notes: id=add is shared by all ADD buttons. With Standard already converted, Premium is now the first VISIBLE #add button (querySelectorAll('button#add') filtered to offsetParent !== null, idx=0).

steps.businessName: click the + icon on the Premium ticket card (2nd unit — takes qty 1→2)
steps.notes: With both Standard and Premium active, there are now TWO #add-item elements. Premium is the 2nd (DOM order idx=1).

steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cnpqaZ0 bubble-r-container relative
steps.notes: Single element, unique id. Click via el.click(). Transition to Step 1 takes ~2s; wait for #main-full-name to appear.

steps.businessName: fill Contact Info Full Name on Step 1
steps.notes: Use native value setter + input+change events for Bubble to pick up the value; plain assignment does not trigger the framework.

steps.businessName: fill Contact Info Email on Step 1
check 'contact info is same for all tickets' checkbox on Step 1
steps.text: checkThe contact information is the same for all tickets
steps.notes: Bubble checkbox rendered as a clickable Group DIV. After checking, the per-ticket fields auto-fill from Contact Info.

steps.businessName: check the 'authorized cardholder' consent checkbox at bottom of Step 1 (just above CONTINUE AS GUEST)
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cpmaJo1 bubble-r-container flex row
steps.text: I am the authorized cardholder for this purchase...
steps.notes: NO id attribute. Currently selecting via: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.clickable-element.bubble-element.Group')).find(e => e.textContent.includes('authorized cardholder')).

steps.businessName: click CONTINUE AS GUEST on Step 1
steps.notes: Transitions to Step 2 (Payment). Wait for #toggle-terms and #complete-order-authnet to appear.

steps.businessName: toggle the Terms & Conditions ionic toggle on Step 2
steps.notes: CRITICAL: click the inner <label> — `document.getElementById('toggle-terms').querySelector('label').click()`. Clicking the outer div can silently no-op and PAY NOW stays inert. Verify with `querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').checked === true` before clicking PAY NOW.

steps.businessName: click PAY NOW on Step 2 — redirects to Authorize.net
steps.notes: Only enabled after toggle-terms input is checked=true. Clicking redirects to test.authorize.net/payment/payment.

missingIdsOnStep1: 'authorized cardholder' consent checkbox (just above CONTINUE AS GUEST) — needs an id to be clickable deterministically
'stay up-to-date via email' opt-in checkbox (not required, but missing id)
